final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s.country, s.avg_wins, s.avg_wins - t.overall_avg AS difference FROM step1 AS s CROSS JOIN step2 AS t WHERE t.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND s.avg_wins > t.overall_avg), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS filtered_avg FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT s.country, s.avg_wins, s.difference, s.avg_wins - t.filtered_avg AS second_difference FROM step3 AS s CROSS JOIN step4 AS t WHERE t.filtered_avg IS NOT NULL AND s.avg_wins > t.filtered_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_wins), AVG(difference), AVG(second_difference) FROM step5
